an4.235:1.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni
an4.235:1.5: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.235:1.6: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.235:1.8: idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti adinnādāyī hoti kāmesu micchācārī hoti musāvādī hoti surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī hoti
an4.235:1.9: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ.
an4.235:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti musāvādā paṭivirato hoti surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
an4.235:2.3: idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ.
an4.235:3.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.235:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco sabyāpajjhaṃpi abyāpajjhaṃpi kāyasaṃkhāraṃ abhisaṃkharoti …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ.
an4.235:4.1: katamañca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati
an4.235:4.2: tatra bhikkhave yampīdaṃ kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ …pe… idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.235:4.3: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
